title: Phase 6 audit DTO boundary cleanup
summary: Moves audit preview DTO imports from desktop compatibility shims to the core-owned inventory DTO module, then removes the now-unused audit NO_CORE_TO_DESKTOP allowlist rows and marks the matching ledger rows migrated.
reason: Phase 6 architecture-boundary cleanup should retire low-risk DTO-only domain slices without changing audit preview payloads, route behavior, WebView commands, media policy, or filesystem/process behavior.
behavior_before: Audit facade and preview policy built AuditPreviewDto through mediapipeline.desktop.application DTO shims, requiring temporary NO_CORE_TO_DESKTOP allowlist entries.
behavior_after: Audit facade and preview policy build the same DTO class through mediapipeline.core.kernel.dto_inventory, while desktop compatibility exports remain unchanged for external callers.
manual_validation: check_dependency_boundaries --format json --report-only - passed (hard=70; allowlisted=70; unallowlisted=0; unused_allowlist=0; NO_CORE_TO_DESKTOP=53; audit=0)
rollback_plan: Restore the audit AuditPreviewDto imports to mediapipeline.desktop.application.dto and dto_inventory, re-add the three audit allowlist rows, revert AB-AUD-002/005/006 to open, and refresh the audit summaries.
notes: Phase 6 audit slice moves AuditPreviewDto imports from desktop shims to core kernel DTOs, removes the audit allowlist rows, marks AB-AUD-002/005/006 migrated, and refreshes audit summaries.
